query:
SELECT 
  cb.id,
  cb.user_id,
  cb.organization_id,
  cb.balance,
  cb.updated_at,
  COUNT(ct.id) as transaction_count,
  MAX(ct.created_at) as last_transaction_date
FROM ai_credit_balance cb
LEFT JOIN ai_credit_transactions ct ON cb.user_id = ct.user_id AND cb.organization_id = ct.organization_id
WHERE cb.user_id = 2580004
GROUP BY cb.id, cb.user_id, cb.organization_id, cb.balance, cb.updated_at
ORDER BY cb.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT 
  id,
  user_id,
  organization_id,
  amount,
  transaction_type,
  description,
  created_at
FROM ai_credit_transactions
WHERE user_id = 2580004
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 20;
